reviews.review: Finally a deep, beautiful, and epic coop experience.  Tons of things to unlock, both with cosmetic and play style.  The procedural generation of the caves can be maddening and breathtaking as you take on random encounters of an ever expanding number of enemy types!  The devs are also very active in the community and have shown a love for their craft and their overall game design. Rock and Stone!

I tried the game at the most recent free weekend at update 23 (update 24 current game state) and I fell in love with this game. Killing bugs is fun, mining is fun, teamplay is fun and the community is awesome. In 350 missons that I played there was only one troll that tried to kill us before I kicked him the rest of my teammates were friendly. Also the developer are active reddit commentators and playing a ton of deep rock, too. I've pretty much reached the end game (unlocked all weapons, weapon attachments, etc. only some cosmetics are missing) and it still doesn't get boring. I spent most of my time playing on hazard 4 (There are 5 Hazard starting from 1 and getting more difficult with each step) because I was scared of Hazard 5 being too hard but since I completed my first Hazard 5 mission I've been playing only Hazard 5. The dwarfs at Hazard 5 are a bit more serious than at lower Hazard levels (less emoting, more rushing through a mission) but the teamplay is way better with expirienced dwarfs. So that makes it even.

great game. played 25 hours. did a bunch of stuff and enjoyed playing with friends and even the girlfriend loved it. reset once. no big all my characters kept levels and i just had to re purchase some upgrades that i'd made and they even gave me my funds back to do so. logged in tonight and everything was reset with 0 progress made on my account. don't buy until finished. ♥♥♥♥ early access its cancer and i can't wait until all these dev companies die.

edit : i revisited this game to play with my gf recently and the save file recovery feature now works. still pisses me off that it wasn't operational before but i've got all my stuff back so thats okay i guess. super fun game. would recommend now that they actually let you recover your files.

Haven't played for a bit and came back to a reset account. I didn't feel like starting over so I checked the discussions and found some weird instructions involving local save files. These files don't exist on my computer for some reason so I posted about it. Got one response asking if I know why the files are not there, when I responded that I don't know they stopped responding. So I guess all that work levling up all classes was for nothing.

Too bad, it was a good game. I just don't feel like doing those 50+ hours over.

This game is truly a gem.   I don't always have time to commit to mastering a co-op game.   In many of them like Left 4 Dead, Warhammer Vermintide, Vermintide 2, etc.   While they are great it can have a leash like effect for people like me that don't play often.   Instead of getting to enjoy a level we must rush and chase after people that have already memorized the levels.   The procedural level generation in Deep Rock Galactic makes that a non-issue, so while there is still the benefit of mastering and knowing how to play it does not result in dragging new players along in memorized levels and not giving them the chance to enjoy it.

This is a great game and easily worth the asking price and it isn't even done yet.   They keep making it better.

It is also quite amusing at times.

Rock and Stone!

For Karl!
